headline: Sales rise but a settlement charge squeezes profit
summary_short: Net sales rose 5% (2% in constant currency) to $3.71B, but diluted EPS fell to $0.24 as an $84M securities class-action settlement, higher restructuring costs, and a jump in the effective tax rate to 50.3% from 34.0% weighed on profit.
summary_long: Net sales grew 5% to $3.71B, led by fragrance, skin care and makeup and by higher sales in Mainland China and EUKEM. Gross margin improved roughly 140bp on PRGP-driven inventory and promotional efficiencies, but operating income fell 19% to $249M and diluted EPS dropped to $0.24 as an $84M securities class-action litigation settlement and higher restructuring charges outweighed the sales and margin gains; the effective tax rate jumped to 50.3% from 34.0%, mainly from reduced U.S. taxable income under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act's interest-deduction limits. The company raised its Restructuring Program targets: workforce cuts to 9,000-10,000 positions, total charges to $1.5-1.7B, and annual gross benefits to $1.0-1.2B. Cash rose to $3.13B; capex fell to $306M from $395M.

drivers.explanation: Net sales grew but profit fell on an $84M securities class-action litigation settlement, higher restructuring charges, and a jump in the effective tax rate.
Net sales grew 5% (2% constant-currency), driven by fragrance, skin care and makeup and by higher sales in Mainland China and EUKEM.
Gross margin rose about 140bp on PRGP benefits — lower excess inventory, accretive new launches, lower promotional activity — partly offset by tariffs and inflation.
Operating margin fell as the securities class-action settlement and higher restructuring costs from the expanded Restructuring Program outweighed higher sales and gross margin gains.
Net income fell further than operating income because the effective tax rate jumped to 50.3% from 34.0%, driven mainly by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act reducing U.S. taxable income.
Cash rose as operating cash flow increased on higher net earnings and lower capex, partially offset by financing outflows including TOM FORD deferred-consideration payments.
